name: CRAG_FREEBASE_CANONICAL
status: AMENDMENT. Supersedes the PIPELINE section of v1; every other v1 clause stands.

amends.v1_rule_being_honoured: sha256 over the contract with this field absent. Any later change to the contract must appear as a new record with its own hash, never as an edit that leaves this one looking prescient.

WHY_AMENDED.trigger: the source contains type.property.reverse_property and freebase.type_hints.mediator, both verified present in the downloaded prefix.
WHY_AMENDED.effect: orientation and CVT classification move from inference to reading. V1 planned five passes partly because reverse orientation had to be reconstructed from IDIR's observed anti-join behaviour and CVT status from a structural classifier. Neither reconstruction is now necessary.

PIPELINE_V2.shape: four logical passes, streaming from gzip throughout

PASS_A.does: schema + metadata, without constructing the graph

REDUNDANCY_IS_MEASURED_NOT_ASSUMED.rdfs:label: dropped only where it is identical to type.object.name FOR THAT SUBJECT. Any differing label is written to label_residue.parquet, and the identical/differing counts are recorded. That is the provenance proving why one was discarded -- not an assumption carried from a prefix sample.
REDUNDANCY_IS_MEASURED_NOT_ASSUMED.rdf:type: NOT collapsed into type.object.type. They were measured non-equivalent. Every rdf:type row with an object outside the freebase ns/ namespace is kept unconditionally (the RDF/OWL vocabulary layer). An ns/-object row is dropped ONLY when that exact assertion is also present as type.object.type for the same subject; anything unmatched is kept as residue and counted.
REDUNDANCY_IS_MEASURED_NOT_ASSUMED.why_per_subject_comparison_is_exact: subject contiguity lets both predicates for a subject be compared in O(1) memory as the stream passes. This is a global comparison, not a sampled one.

PASS_B.does: canonical graph stream. For every subject block, classify each RDF term and emit canonical graph candidates.
PASS_B.classification_inputs: PASS A's mediator declarations and property schema. PASS B reads a label, it does not invent one.

PASS_C.why_it_exists: subject discovery can stream because the source is subject-grouped, but objects arrive in arbitrary order and many nodes may appear ONLY as objects.
PASS_C.method: external union/dedup of (subjects seen) + (objects seen) + (literal ids) -> canonical node universe

EXPLICIT_PROHIBITION.must_not_assume: 'every object eventually appears as a subject'
EXPLICIT_PROHIBITION.why: V1's g.* finding already showed object-only populations are real. An assumption of eventual subject-appearance would silently delete exactly the node class that finding identified.

PASS_D.does: reverse canonicalisation from the source's own reverse-property map, not from IDIR's derived behaviour
PASS_D.rule: for each reverse pair P <-> Q, choose one canonical stored orientation and store the fact ONCE, retaining both predicate identities as metadata: canonical_relation and reverse_relation.
PASS_D.consequence: A --P--> B is stored physically once, while traversal may read both A --P--> B and B --Q--> A. Bidirectional traversal without duplicate semantic facts.
PASS_D.what_this_avoids: storing the ~45% reverse duplication IDIR measured, without inheriting the anti-join annihilation edge case where BOTH halves of a pair are removed. Check 5 bounded that case at 25 predicates / 17,930 triples precisely because the reverse map was unavailable; PASS D no longer has to bound it.

LITERAL_IDENTITY_V2.ENCODING_RULE: the three components are length-prefixed before hashing, not concatenated with a separator. A separator can be forged by a literal containing that separator, which would be an identity collapse of exactly the class this rule exists to prevent.

stored_alongside.raw_rdf_term: the original N-Triples term, escapes intact
stored_alongside.display_text: the human-readable surface used for textualisation

LITERAL_IDENTITY_V2.why_three_fields: the display surface must never become the identity. Keeping the raw term means the identity is auditable back to the source byte string.

values.STRUCTURAL_CLASSIFIER_<tau>: fallback only, for nodes the source does not label

NODE_KIND_PROVENANCE.why: V1 had to infer CVT_MEDIATOR structurally. V3 reads it. Recording the SOURCE of a classification makes the two distinguishable in every downstream analysis instead of blending inferred and declared labels into one column.

THE_OLD_CLASSIFIER_BECOMES_AN_INSTRUMENT.question: how accurately does our structural classifier reproduce actual Freebase mediator declarations?
THE_OLD_CLASSIFIER_BECOMES_AN_INSTRUMENT.status: an experiment, not a dependency. It now has ground truth to be scored against, which it never had in V1.
THE_OLD_CLASSIFIER_BECOMES_AN_INSTRUMENT.supersedes: the pending ratio-threshold classifier pre-registration, which was written when no source label was known to exist. It remains live only for whatever population the declaration does not cover -- itself a quantity PASS A reports.

SUBJECT_CONTIGUITY_IS_PROVISIONAL.evidence_so_far: 859,492 subject blocks == 859,492 distinct subjects, 0 reopened, over a 3 GB prefix sample
SUBJECT_CONTIGUITY_IS_PROVISIONAL.gate: only if REOPENED_SUBJECT_BLOCKS_N == 0 over the whole verified source may PASS B skip subject-side external sorting.
SUBJECT_CONTIGUITY_IS_PROVISIONAL.if_nonzero: the subject side needs the same external sort the object side needs. The build still works; it just costs what v1 budgeted.
SUBJECT_CONTIGUITY_IS_PROVISIONAL.COMPARISON_RULE: sortedness must be evaluated on the identifier between '<...ns/' and '>', never on the bracketed URI. '>' is 0x3E and digits begin at 0x30, so the bracketed form reports a false violation on every prefix pair (m.010l_ vs m.010l_0k1). A strictly increasing opener sequence proves contiguity in O(1) memory; the exact-duplicate fallback is only needed if that fails.

IDIR_AS_CONTINUOUS_PARSER_ORACLE.premise: IDIR's retained structural portion agreed with the NSM backbone at 99.998% on covered predicates, with zero reverse-only cases. That makes it a parser oracle, and it became MORE useful after being rejected as the canonical graph.
IDIR_AS_CONTINUOUS_PARSER_ORACLE.procedure: after PASS B, project our graph to the slice IDIR retained -- MID->MID edges only, IDIR's predicate set, IDIR's orientation -- and compare against oracle/backbone_triples.parquet (134,142,730 triples).
IDIR_AS_CONTINUOUS_PARSER_ORACLE.method_fixed_in_advance: map our MIDs through oracle/backbone_entity2id.parquet and our predicates through oracle/backbone_relation2id.parquet, then bit-pack (subject_id, relation_id, object_id) into int64 keys and compare as sorted arrays. Same packing checks 2 and 4 used, so the numbers are comparable to those already recorded.

PRE_REGISTERED_DECISION_RULE.REPRODUCTION_RATE: share of IDIR's 134,142,730 triples our projection reproduces
PRE_REGISTERED_DECISION_RULE.INVESTIGATE: 99.0% to 99.9% -- do NOT proceed. A discrepancy this size is real and must be explained and recorded before any downstream pass runs.
PRE_REGISTERED_DECISION_RULE.STOP: < 99.0% -- the parser, reverse treatment, filtering or identity construction is wrong. Fix the cause; do not tune the comparison.
PRE_REGISTERED_DECISION_RULE.ALSO_MEASURED: excess rate -- edges we emit inside IDIR's own node and predicate universe that IDIR does not have. Some excess is expected and legitimate, because IDIR dropped literal-valued facts and we do not. Excess restricted to MID->MID edges over IDIR's retained predicates is NOT expected and is treated as a defect signal.
PRE_REGISTERED_DECISION_RULE.anti_gaming_clause: these thresholds are fixed now precisely so a disappointing number cannot be met by redefining the projection afterwards.

DISK_DISCIPLINE.budget: ~81 GB free before the mirror, ~50 GB after it lands.
DISK_DISCIPLINE.PROHIBITED: holding a raw edge serialisation, a sorted serialisation and a Parquet serialisation of the same data at the same time.
DISK_DISCIPLINE.REQUIRED_SHAPE: gzip source -> stream -> compressed shards -> external merge -> final Parquet
DISK_DISCIPLINE.DELETION_GATE: merge inputs are deleted only after the merged output passes ALL of: row count, content hash, schema check, endpoint integrity (every edge endpoint resolves in the node universe).
DISK_DISCIPLINE.why_this_gate_is_strict: the IDIR archive is the standing warning. A ZIP that opened cleanly still had three fields corrupted by the same 32-bit overflow, and only CRC verification caught it. Treat every artifact as invalid until counts and checksums say otherwise.

ACQUISITION_GATE.note: v1's plan named size/md5/sha1. crc32 is published by the Internet Archive too and is now also enforced, so the gate uses everything the source metadata offers.
ACQUISITION_GATE.rename_rule: freebase-rdf-latest.gz.part -> freebase-rdf-latest.gz ONLY on a full pass. No pass may read the source before the rename.

CONTRACT_HASH_NOTE: sha256 over this amendment with this field absent. The v1 hash is recorded under 'amends' and v1's file is unmodified, so the two records can be diffed by anyone later.
